implemented_requirements.evidence: In `Game.update`, when `self.claw == 'swing'` the angle is updated with a speed and direction, bounded by AMIN/AMAX (lines handling `self.angle` and `self.dirn`).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player times a grab to collect gold or other objects
implemented_requirements.evidence: Key bindings `<space>` and `<Button-1>` call `on_key`; when playing and claw is swinging, `self.claw` is set to `'extend'` to start the grab (see `on_key`).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Each object has a value and takes time to reel in
implemented_requirements.evidence: Objects are created from `SPEC` with a `value` field; `Obj.__init__` stores it. During retraction, speed is scaled by `self.carried.weight` (`self.length -= (300.0 / w) * dt`), making heavier objects take longer to reel in.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Level ends when time runs out or the minimum gold value is met
implemented_requirements.evidence: `self.time_left` counts down in `update`; when it reaches 0 the state becomes `'clear'` if `self.score >= self.goal` else `'over'`. Also, when `self.score >= self.goal` during play the state is set to `'clear'`.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display the position of the claw and objects, updating after each grab
implemented_requirements.evidence: `draw` clears the canvas and redraws all objects (`draw_obj`) and the claw line based on `self.tip()` after each update.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Introduce ascending difficulty with more obstacles or tighter time limits
implemented_requirements.evidence: `reset_level` adds more rocks and TNT based on `self.level` and reduces `self.time_left` (`max(28, 62 - (self.level - 1) * 4)`).

critical_issues: The program requires a graphical environment with Tkinter; it will not run in a headless CI environment.
Weight influences retraction speed but the exact "time to reel in" per object is implicit rather than explicitly displayed.
judge.summary: The provided `main.py` implements a functional Gold Miner game meeting all core benchmark requirements: swinging claw, timed grab, valued objects, level termination conditions, visual updates, and progressive difficulty. The code is complete and likely runnable on a system with Tkinter, so the submission passes.
